description: Get model answers without giving callers the provider key. Ask a question or request a structured decision. Send ask with a prompt, or decide with a decision request.
author: Serg Parf

ask.help: Get a model answer. Send prompt text for a text reply, or an OpenAI chat request for the provider response as JSON.

args.name: prompt
args.help: Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON

decide.help: Get answers to typed decision questions. Send an OpenRouter Decisions request; the reply is the full provider response as JSON.

args.name: body
args.help: Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged

model.help: Default chat model ID for ask/text and chat JSON requests without model; not injected into decide

base_url.help: Trusted OpenAI-compatible API root; chat/completions is appended for ask, decide uses the same origin at /api/alpha/decisions
